chain.title: Certus Quartz Crystal
chain.desc: Mined from the Certus Quartz Clusters growing on budding certus blocks inside a sky-stone meteorite; each cluster drops four crystals.

chain.title: Sky Stone
chain.desc: The dark rock that forms the body of every meteorite; dig it out of the crater, or smelt Sky Stone Dust back into it.

chain.title: Charger
chain.desc: Built from iron and copper ingots; feed it power or slap a Wooden Crank on the side and turn it by hand.

chain.title: Charged Certus Quartz Crystal
chain.desc: Drop a Certus Quartz Crystal into a Charger and let it finish; this is the reagent for every in-world crafting recipe.

chain.title: Meteorite Compass
chain.desc: Charge a vanilla Compass in the Charger; its needle then points at the nearest Mysterious Cube instead of spawn.

chain.title: Inscriber Presses
chain.desc: Break the Mysterious Cube buried at a meteorite's core and it drops all four Inscriber presses at once, silicon press included.

chain.title: Inscriber
chain.desc: Iron ingots, copper and a sticky piston; presses go in the top and bottom slots and stamp materials in the middle slot.

chain.title: Fluix Crystal
chain.desc: Throw a Charged Certus Quartz Crystal, redstone and nether quartz into a water source block and they fuse into two Fluix Crystals.

chain.title: Silicon
chain.desc: Smelt Certus Quartz Dust, which the Inscriber grinds out of any certus quartz crystal placed in its middle slot.

chain.title: Logic Processor
chain.desc: Press a gold-printed logic circuit onto Printed Silicon with redstone between them in the Inscriber.

chain.title: Calculation Processor
chain.desc: The same Inscriber press, but with a printed circuit stamped from a Certus Quartz Crystal instead of gold.

chain.title: Engineering Processor
chain.desc: Top processor tier: a diamond-printed circuit pressed onto Printed Silicon with redstone; gates drives, controllers and CPUs.

chain.title: Growth Accelerator
chain.desc: Iron, quartz glass, a fluix cable and a Fluix Block; powered and placed against budding certus it turns crystals into a renewable farm.

chain.title: ME Glass Cable
chain.desc: A Quartz Fiber plus two Fluix Crystals; the basic wire that carries channels between every ME device.

chain.title: Energy Acceptor
chain.desc: Iron, quartz glass and copper; it converts FE from your generators into the AE the network actually runs on.

chain.title: 1k ME Item Storage Cell
chain.desc: A 1k Storage Component (certus quartz, redstone and a Logic Processor) sealed in an iron and quartz-glass housing.

chain.title: ME Drive
chain.desc: Iron, an Engineering Processor and two glass cables; holds ten storage cells and makes their contents part of the network.

chain.title: ME Terminal
chain.desc: Shapeless from a Formation Core, an Annihilation Core, a Logic Processor and an Illuminated Panel; your window into stored items.

chain.title: ME Controller
chain.desc: Smooth Sky Stone, Fluix Crystals and an Engineering Processor; required once a network needs more than eight channels, and it hands them out.

chain.title: Molecular Assembler
chain.desc: A crafting table between an Annihilation and a Formation Core; it executes encoded patterns and is the engine of autocrafting.

chain.title: ME Pattern Provider
chain.desc: A crafting table framed in iron with both cores; it pushes the ingredients of an encoded pattern into assemblers or machines.

chain.title: 1k Crafting Storage
chain.desc: A Crafting Unit plus a 1k Storage Component; stack these with a Co-Processing Unit to form a Crafting CPU that runs autocraft jobs.

chain.title: Wireless Terminal
chain.desc: Wireless Receiver, ME Terminal and a Dense Energy Cell; reaches the network from anywhere inside a Wireless Access Point's radius.

chain.title: ME Quantum Ring
chain.desc: Eight rings around a Quantum Link Chamber form the Quantum Network Bridge, linking two networks across any distance via paired Quantum Entangled Singularities.

notes: Verified against appliedenergistics2-forge-15.4.10.jar (Forge, MC 1.20.1). Every id above was confirmed to have both an item model in assets/ae2/models/item/ and an item./block. lang key in assets/ae2/lang/en_us.json. Key facts for this version: there is NO certus quartz ore in world generation - certus quartz exists only in meteorites (budding certus blocks with buds and clusters), so the very first step is finding a meteorite, and the Meteorite Compass (vanilla compass charged in a Charger) is the intended locator. The Charger itself needs no AE2 materials (iron + copper) and can be hand-powered by a Wooden Crank (ae2:crank), so it is craftable before the player owns any AE2 resource. All four Inscriber presses drop together from the Mysterious Cube (ae2:mysterious_cube) at the centre of a meteorite - presses are NOT craftable from scratch, only duplicable (press + iron block in an Inscriber). ae2:silicon_press stands in for the whole press set in this chain. DROPPED ids: 'ae2:security_station' - the ME Security Station/Terminal was removed in AE2 15.x; a leftover item model exists in the jar but there is no lang key and no recipe, so it is not a real obtainable item. 'ae2:quartz_ore' / 'ae2:charged_quartz_ore' - named by older wikis, do not exist in this jar. No dim: entry was added: data/ae2/dimension/ does not exist in the jar (the Spatial Storage dimension is registered in code, only data/ae2/dimension_type/spatial_storage.json is shipped), so no dimension id could be verified. No kill: entry was added: the only AE2 entity lang key is entity.ae2.tiny_tnt_primed, which is a projectile, not a mob. Side branches deliberately left out to stay under the entry cap: Spatial Storage (ae2:spatial_pylon, ae2:spatial_io_port, ae2:spatial_storage_cell_2), Matter Condenser endgame (ae2:condenser -> ae2:matter_ball -> ae2:singularity -> ae2:quantum_entangled_singularity, which the Quantum Ring bridge actually needs to pair), P2P tunnels, and the higher cell tiers (4k/16k/64k/256k) which follow the same pattern as the 1k entries listed.
